t: Occultism Spirits can work inside $(l:machines/mob_jar)Containment Jars$(/l). They maintain their original behaviour and $(thing)do not decay$() making them perfect from automations! $(br2)Spirit Jar will automatically pickup any item in 7x7 centered around it that matches spirit's filter (for crushing spirits, it will automatically pickup any ore that it can process).
神秘学的魔灵能在$(l:machines/mob_jar)收容罐$(/l)中工作。它们的行为一如往常，同时$(thing)不会灵髓衰退$()，非常适合自动化！$(br2)魔灵罐会自动捡起以自身为中心7x7范围内符合过滤标准的任意物品（例如，碎矿者魔灵会自行捡起它能处理的所有矿石）。

Items can also be pushed into the containment jar using a hopper or starbuncles (any pipe should also work!). Players can also right-click any item directly on the jar. $(br2)Spirits in Jars exhibit their default behaviour, this means that a $(thing)Crusher Spirit$() will automatically process and fling the output in one of directions
也可用漏斗和星宝石兽将物品送入收容罐（管道也应该没问题！）。玩家还可直接用物品直接右击收容罐。$(br2)罐中魔灵的行为不会改变，也即$(thing)碎矿者魔灵$()会自动处理并向某一方向弹出产物。
Janitor Spirits inside jars have a special property. They automatically try to pickup items nearby and push to inventory next to it. This makes automation super easy!
罐中的清洁工魔灵有一独特的性质。它们会尝试捡起周围的物品，并放入与收容罐相邻的容器。自动化也因此变得非常简单了！
